facts.fact: Decree 2023-244/PR/MDENI institutes the Haut Conseil Supérieur de l'Economie Numérique et de l'Innovation (HCSENI), chaired by the President, to supervise, follow and evaluate the national digital economy and innovation strategy, with a steering committee under the digital minister to coordinate its updating and execution; dated by the document's published date (the decree was heard in Council of Ministers on 6 June 2023).
